on.title: Enable Plan
on.description: Are you sure you want to enable this plan? It will be available for subscription immediately.

off.title: Disable Plan
off.description: Are you sure you want to disable this plan? Customers will no longer be able to subscribe.

on.title: Make Plan Visible
on.description: Are you sure you want to make this plan visible? It will be available for subscription immediately.

off.title: Make Plan Hidden
off.description: Are you sure you want to make this plan hidden? Customers will no longer be able to see it.

on.title: Enable Employee
on.description: Are you sure you want to enable this employee?

off.title: Disable Employee
off.description: Are you sure you want to disable this employee?

on.title: Enable Account
on.description: Are you sure you want to enable this account?

off.title: Disable Account
off.description: Are you sure you want to disable this account?

on.title: Are you sure you want to set this account as the default?
on.description: This account will be set as the default account, used as the primary account with an initial balance, and will be active when new accounts are added.

off.title: This account cannot be set as default
off.description: There must be at least one account set as the default account.

on.title: Activate country / currency
on.description: This will make the country/currency available on the platform and visible where it is used.

off.title: Deactivate country / currency
off.description: This will disable the country/currency across the platform. It may be hidden from lists and blocked for new operations.

on.title: Activate
on.description: This will enable the selected item across the platform. It will be available for use and new operations.

off.title: Deactivate
off.description: This will disable the selected item across the platform. It may be hidden from selection and blocked for new operations.

on.title: Show
on.description: This will make the selected item visible in the dashboard and available in selection lists.

off.title: Hide
off.description: This will hide the selected item from the dashboard and selection lists. Existing data will not be deleted.
